title: Erkin muloqot

entries.en: Hi, how's your day going?
Have we met before?
I don't think we've been introduced.
entries.ru: Кажется, нас ещё не представили друг другу.

entries.en: Mind if I join you?
Is this seat taken?
How do you know everyone here?
It's quite busy here today.
What brings you here?
entries.uz: Bu yerga nima sabab bilan keldingiz?

entries.en: Have you been here long?
It's nice to finally meet you.
How's your day been?
It's been a busy day.
I've had a pretty good day.
Anything interesting happen today?
It's been one of those days.
entries.ru: Сегодня был один из тех непростых дней.
entries.uz: Bugun oʻsha qiyin kunlardan biri boʻldi.

entries.en: I'm looking forward to the weekend.
entries.uz: Dam olish kunlarini intiqlik bilan kutyapman.

entries.en: Today went by so quickly.
entries.uz: Bugungi kun juda tez oʻtib ketdi.

entries.en: I could use a little break.
entries.ru: Мне бы не помешал небольшой перерыв.
entries.uz: Menga bir oz tanaffus kerak edi.

entries.en: It's finally time to relax.
How's your week going so far?
How's work going?
What are you working on these days?
How long have you been doing that?
entries.uz: Bu ish bilan qancha vaqtdan beri shugʻullanasiz?

entries.en: Do you enjoy what you do?
entries.ru: Тебе нравится то, чем ты занимаешься?

entries.en: How's your course going?
Have you been busy lately?
What's the best part of your job?
entries.ru: Что тебе больше всего нравится в работе?

entries.en: I'm learning something new at the moment.
entries.uz: Hozir men yangi bir narsani oʻrganyapman.

entries.en: That sounds like an interesting job.
I hope work isn't too stressful.
What do you do for fun?
What do you like doing in your free time?
entries.ru: Что ты любишь делать в свободное время?

entries.en: Have you picked up any new hobbies?
I'm really into music.
Do you play any sports?
I like trying new things.
entries.uz: Menga yangi narsalarni sinab koʻrish yoqadi.

entries.en: What kind of books do you read?
Have you seen any good films lately?
I spend a lot of time outdoors.
entries.ru: Я много времени провожу на свежем воздухе.
entries.uz: Men koʻp vaqtimni ochiq havoda oʻtkazaman.

entries.en: That sounds like a fun hobby.
Any plans for the weekend?
I'm keeping it low-key this weekend.
entries.ru: В эти выходные я планирую спокойно отдохнуть.
entries.uz: Bu dam olish kunlarini tinchgina oʻtkazmoqchiman.

entries.en: I'm meeting some friends.
We're thinking of going out.
Do you want to do something together?
I haven't made any plans yet.
Hopefully, the weather will be nice.
I'm planning to catch up on sleep.
That sounds like a good way to spend the weekend.
entries.ru: Звучит как хороший способ провести выходные.
entries.uz: Dam olish kunlarini oʻtkazishning yaxshi usuliga oʻxshaydi.

entries.en: Enjoy your weekend!
Have you tried this place before?
entries.ru: Ты раньше бывал(а) в этом месте?

entries.en: What's your go-to coffee order?
Do you have a favourite restaurant?
I'm always up for good food.
entries.ru: Я всегда не против вкусно поесть.
entries.uz: Men doim mazali taomdan boʻsh kelmayman.

entries.en: That smells amazing.
What would you recommend here?
I'm trying to eat a bit healthier.
entries.uz: Men biroz sogʻlomroq ovqatlanishga harakat qilyapman.

entries.en: Do you prefer tea or coffee?
We should try that place sometime.
entries.ru: Нам стоит как-нибудь попробовать то место.
entries.uz: Qachondir oʻsha joyni sinab koʻrishimiz kerak.

entries.en: This is exactly what I needed.
entries.ru: Это именно то, что мне было нужно.
entries.uz: Bu aynan menga kerak boʻlgan narsa edi.

entries.en: Have you travelled anywhere recently?
entries.uz: Soʻnggi paytlarda biror joyga sayohat qildingizmi?

entries.en: What's your favourite place you've visited?
entries.ru: Какое место из посещённых тебе понравилось больше всего?
entries.uz: Borgan joylaringizdan qaysi biri eng yoqqan?

entries.en: I'd love to visit that place.
entries.ru: Я бы с удовольствием посетил(а) это место.
entries.uz: Men oʻsha joyga borishni juda xohlardim.

entries.en: Do you travel often?
What's it like living here?
Is there much to do around here?
I still have so many places to see.
entries.ru: Мне ещё столько мест нужно увидеть.
entries.uz: Hali koʻrishim kerak boʻlgan joylar juda koʻp.

entries.en: I prefer travelling in the off-season.
entries.ru: Я предпочитаю путешествовать не в сезон.
entries.uz: Men mavsumdan tashqari sayohat qilishni afzal koʻraman.

entries.en: What's the best trip you've ever taken?
entries.ru: Какая поездка была лучшей в твоей жизни?
entries.uz: Hayotingizdagi eng yaxshi sayohat qaysi edi?

entries.en: I'd recommend it to anyone.
entries.uz: Men buni hammaga tavsiya qilgan boʻlardim.

entries.en: Lovely weather we're having.
It's a bit chilly today.
It's warmer than I expected.
Looks like it's going to rain.
I hope it clears up soon.
The weather has been all over the place.
entries.ru: Погода в последнее время постоянно меняется.

entries.en: It's perfect weather for a walk.
I can't believe how hot it is.
entries.uz: Bu qadar issiq boʻlishiga ishonib boʻlmaydi.

entries.en: At least it's not too windy.
entries.ru: По крайней мере, не слишком ветрено.

entries.en: I love this time of year.
entries.uz: Men yilning shu faslini yaxshi koʻraman.

entries.en: How's your family doing?
Do you have any brothers or sisters?
entries.ru: У тебя есть братья или сёстры?

entries.en: Are you close to your family?
entries.ru: Ты близок / близка со своей семьёй?

entries.en: How did you two meet?
We go way back.
I haven't seen them in ages.
entries.ru: Я их целую вечность не видел(а).
entries.uz: Men ularni ancha vaqtdan beri koʻrmaganman.

entries.en: We try to get together regularly.
entries.uz: Biz muntazam uchrashib turishga harakat qilamiz.

entries.en: Your friend seems really nice.
entries.ru: Твой друг кажется очень приятным человеком.

entries.en: Please say hello to your family for me.
It's always good to catch up with old friends.
entries.ru: Всегда приятно повидаться со старыми друзьями.
entries.uz: Eski doʻstlar bilan koʻrishish doim yoqimli.

entries.en: Have you watched anything good lately?
entries.uz: Soʻnggi paytlarda yaxshi biror narsa koʻrdingizmi?

entries.en: What kind of music are you into?
Have you heard of this band?
I've been listening to them a lot.
entries.ru: Я много их слушаю в последнее время.
entries.uz: Men ularni soʻnggi paytlarda koʻp tinglayapman.

entries.en: That show is really popular right now.
I'm thinking of going to a concert.
Do you prefer films or series?
The ending caught me by surprise.
I couldn't stop watching.
entries.ru: Я не мог(ла) оторваться от просмотра.

entries.en: We should check it out sometime.
entries.ru: Нам стоит как-нибудь это посмотреть / посетить.

entries.en: I like your style.
That's a great jacket.
You have a great sense of humour.
You always know what to say.
You make this look easy.
That's a really good idea.
You have great taste in music.
It's always fun talking to you.
You look well-rested.
I love your positive attitude.
How about you?
What happened next?
Tell me more about that.
Really? How come?
What was that like?
And how did you feel about it?
entries.ru: И что ты по этому поводу почувствовал(а)?
entries.uz: Bu haqda oʻzingiz nima his qildingiz?

entries.en: That reminds me of something.
I know exactly what you mean.
entries.ru: Я прекрасно понимаю, что ты имеешь в виду.
entries.uz: Nima demoqchi ekaningizni juda yaxshi tushunaman.

entries.en: No kidding!
So, what happened in the end?
What were you like as a child?
entries.ru: Каким / какой ты был(а) в детстве?

entries.en: I used to do that all the time.
I haven't thought about that in years.
entries.ru: Я не вспоминал(а) об этом много лет.
entries.uz: Men bu haqda yillar davomida oʻylamagan ekanman.

entries.en: That brings back memories.
Those were the days.
I remember it like it was yesterday.
entries.ru: Я помню это как будто вчера.

entries.en: We had so much fun back then.
entries.ru: Тогда мы так весело проводили время.

entries.en: How has it changed since then?
entries.ru: Как это изменилось с тех пор?

entries.en: I learned a lot from that experience.
entries.ru: Я многому научился / научилась благодаря этому опыту.
entries.uz: Men bu tajribadan koʻp narsa oʻrgandim.

entries.en: I'd love to do that again someday.
entries.ru: Я бы хотел(а) когда-нибудь повторить это.
entries.uz: Men buni qachondir yana qilishni xohlardim.

entries.en: What are you looking forward to?
I hope to travel more next year.
entries.ru: Надеюсь больше путешествовать в следующем году.
entries.uz: Kelgusi yili koʻproq sayohat qilsam deyman.

entries.en: I'd like to learn another language.
entries.ru: Я хотел(а) бы выучить ещё один язык.

entries.en: Let's see what the future brings.
I have a few things planned.
I'm excited about what's next.
entries.ru: Я с интересом жду того, что будет дальше.

entries.en: One day, I'd love to...
I'm working toward that goal.
entries.uz: Men shu maqsad sari harakat qilyapman.

entries.en: Hopefully, things will work out.
That gives me something to look forward to.
entries.uz: Endi menda kutadigan narsa paydo boʻldi.

At least we can laugh about it now.

That's one way to put it.
You read my mind.
